title: AI Threat Detection
content_md: AI threat detection is the use of artificial intelligence (AI), especially machine learning, to find signs of a cyber attack in security data. Instead of matching activity against known threats, it learns how users, devices, and systems normally behave and flags activity that breaks from that pattern.
